title: Madison Common Council president rules out reelection, mayoral run - Channel 3000
text: MADISON, Wis. — Common Council President Sabrina Madison said Sunday that she will not seek reelection as the District 17 alder or run for mayor. Madison, who has represented District 17 since October 2022, made the announcement amid speculation that she would enter the mayoral race. Madison Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway recently told News 3 Now in an exclusive television interview that she would not seek reelection. Madison said she has accepted a job outside Wisconsin that begins in August. "It's an opportunity that represents something different for me, and I'm excited about exploring it," she said. Alder Madison has pushed for police body cameras in the city following the fatal shooting of Corey Ruiz in July. Late last month, the common council president joined 13 other alders in voting to fire interim independent police monitor Aeiramique Glass. Madison also said she will begin studying journalism in January and looks forward to spending more time with her family. ​COPYRIGHT 2026 BY CHANNEL 3000. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.
